title: Anduril
description: Defence-tech dark: a near-black page with white text for the film and product tiles, then flat full-bleed bands of stone grey, warm cream and olive drab with black or white text. One neo-grotesk (Instrument Sans) at 400/500/700, tight display sizes, 2px corners, edge-to-edge layout with a 20–32px gutter. A lime accent kept for focus and glows. Light sibling: the cream page with black text and the same bands.
notes: Instrument Sans stands in for the original's Helvetica Now Display (closed): same neo-grotesk shapes and large x-height
secondary is the stone-grey band (black text); accent is the olive band (white text); card is the cream news band
muted is the dark placeholder surface for media slots; primary, highlight and glow are the sparing lime
--page-gutter is fluid (20px on phones, 32px at 1440) and --page-width is effectively full width
